body_text:
For subsets of a fixed universe $U$, union and intersection are
associative, commutative, and idempotent; each distributes over
the other. With complement $A^c=U\setminus A$, they satisfy De
Morgan's laws $(A\cup B)^c=A^c\cap B^c$ and
$(A\cap B)^c=A^c\cup B^c$. The reference to $U$ is part of the
definition of complement.
